facts.business: Khyati Multimedia Entertainment Limited is primarily engaged in the business of advertising and organized a Polo Championship event during 2024-25 and 2025-26.

auditor.name: M/s. MAAK And Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: (A) Advance against Land of Rs 2,08,75,000 without registration or confirmations; (B) Polo Championship event not covered by MoA; (C) Revenue recognition from event not aligned with Ind AS 115 and lack of contracts; (D) Customer advances outstanding >365 days deemed deposits under Companies Act, non-compliance. Emphasis: Investment in Khyati Retail & Eatery Private Limited carried at book value without fair value evidence.

key_risks: Advance against land of Rs 2.0875 crore without registration or party confirmations
Polo Championship event not covered by Memorandum of Association
Revenue recognition from event not compliant with Ind AS 115, lack of contracts with sponsors/franchisees/broadcasters
Customer advances outstanding over 365 days deemed deposits under Companies Act, non-compliance with deposit rules
Investment in Khyati Retail & Eatery Private Limited at book value without fair value verification
facts.related_party_note: Omnibus approval sought for related party transactions with Mrs. Jignaben K Patel, Khyati Realities Limited, Khyati World Educate Private Limited, Khyati World School (Unit of Firdaus Memorial Charitable Trust), Khyati Foundation, Khyati Fincap, and other related parties for sale/purchase of goods/services at arm's length prices for FY 2026-27 and ratification of transactions done in FY 2025-26.
